description:
A potato leaves the potato village to achieve his dream. However, there are hardships outside the potato village.  
As soon as he leaves the village, he gets caught up in an unexpected murder and is in danger. Can he return to potato village safely?

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=759418), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=5763840)
